audience: sales and support teams that call and text customers from Kixie

useCases.title: Check whether an agent is logged in and on a call
useCases.text: Check the agent status before a call. An offline agent is a valid answer, not an error.

useCases.title: Review the event webhooks on the account
useCases.text: List the webhooks that send call, SMS, disposition and voicemail events for this account.

useCases.title: Start a call through an agent
useCases.text: Check that the agent is logged in. Then start the call. Kixie rings the agent first, then dials the target. This places a billed call.

useCases.title: Send an SMS or a first team SMS to a customer
useCases.text: Send one SMS from the agent's number. Or send a first team SMS from a team number. Each message is delivered and billed.

useCases.title: Feed a queue or a powerlist with leads
useCases.text: Add a contact to a powerlist, or send a contact to a queue. Remove numbers from a powerlist or a queue when they are no longer needed.
